steps.title: Define Project Metadata
steps.description: Configure the core application metadata including app name 'Monkey Fun' and unique bundle package ID 'com.monkeyfun.app' to initialize development environment parameters.

steps.title: Establish Build Script Parameters
steps.description: Create root and module build.gradle configurations targeting compileSdkVersion 34, specifying AGP version 8.3.2, and enabling Java 8 compatibility configurations.

steps.title: Configure Manifest Attributes
steps.description: Implement AndroidManifest.xml referencing the launcher activity MainActivity, setting customized hardware-accelerated modes, and declaring direct app icons.

steps.title: Develop Interactive UI Layout Structure
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml containing a vertical orientation split into a tropical-styled header, a multi-panel frame display for navigation panels, and a custom footer tab navigator.

steps.title: Incorporate Dynamic Audio Synthesis Engine
steps.description: Construct pure Java-based AudioTrack synthesizer inside MainActivity to programmatically output distinct monkey noises (screeches, chatters, howl growls, catch alerts) without external media assets.

steps.title: Program Catch the Banana Game Loop
steps.description: Design an interactive Custom View inside MainActivity executing a real-time game loop via Handler, processing banana spawning physics, drag-to-catch controls, and collision detection.

steps.title: Implement Vector Canvas Cartoon Rendering
steps.description: Write advanced low-level Canvas draw commands in MainActivity to draw cartoon-like monkey characters (head, mask, eyes, ears, smile) and bananas from basic geometric arcs and paint colors.

steps.title: Integrate Monkey Facts Carousel Logic
steps.description: Populate an indexed facts library database and implement responsive transitions allowing users to scroll, view, and read fun educational trivia details regarding monkeys.

steps.title: Initialize Preference Storage Integration
steps.description: Create local storage link via SharedPreferences in MainActivity to store and load player scores, ensuring persistence of the high score record across application reboots.

steps.title: Building Monkey Fun
steps.description: Compile the complete 'Monkey Fun' application source tree, verifying layout integrity, programmatic sound parameters, canvas loops, and build system configuration.
